snippet.title: Media Circus - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
What becomes news when you're the one deciding what makes the front page?

Media Circus is a satirical narrative-strategy newsroom sim where you launch your own newspaper and try to survive the pressures of the news business in a colorful animal world.

Direct reporters, plan stories and design your newspaper as you decide which headlines deserve attention and which ads keep the money coming in. Grow your readership, manage your profits and navigate competing factions all fighting for a piece of your front page.

Every editorial, narrative and financial decision shapes the world around you. Build a serious investigative newspaper, chase profits as a tabloid, become a propaganda mouthpiece or find your own path — with your choices leading to hundreds of different stories and endings.

Wishlist Media Circus now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3868010/Media_Circus/

A new free demo launches on Steam August 24, 2026.

Coming to PC in Q2 2027, with consoles planned for the future.
